summary: The agent provides a mostly well-structured pipeline that correctly splits data prior to feature engineering and evaluates an ensemble of models across multiple seeds. However, it relies on naive unweighted ensembling, computes only a single metric (RMSE), and critically introduces target leakage by calculating categorical target encodings over the whole training fold without cross-validation.
